title: Duplicate URL name makes the legacy fast routes ambiguous
reasoning: Both legacy fast endpoints are registered with the same name, "fast_on_date". Django permits duplicate URL names, but any code using reverse("fast_on_date") or named links cannot unambiguously target either /api/user/fasts/ or /api/fast/. Because the two routes are handled by different views, FastOnDate and FastOnDateWithoutUser, this can generate the wrong URL for clients or tests that rely on route names rather than hard-coded paths.
recommendation: Give /api/fast/ a distinct URL name, for example "fast_on_date_without_user", and update any reverse() callers that should target the unauthenticated legacy endpoint.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests exercise fast view query behavior and serializers, but none assert URL reversing or uniqueness of the route names for the legacy fast endpoints.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a URL test that asserts reverse() for the authenticated and unauthenticated legacy fast endpoints resolves to distinct paths.
minimumFixScope: Change only the name argument for the /api/fast/ route and any direct reverse() call sites that depend on the old duplicate name.
